interactions.createNode: Activate Add place or Add transition; exactly one node is added.
interactions.select: Activate a place, transition, or arc to select it and expose the applicable inspector fields.
interactions.moveNode: Pointer-drag a place or transition from its rendered center to the drop position.
interactions.createArc: Activate Draw arc, then pointer-drag the source node to the destination node.
interactions.fireTransition: Select a transition, then activate Fire selected transition.
interactions.deleteSelection: Select a node or arc, then activate Delete selection.
interactions.editField: Change the named inspector field and dispatch input followed by change.
interactions.importJson: Set one JSON file on the Import JSON file input exposed by the Import JSON control.
interactions.exportJson: Activate Export JSON and capture the downloaded JSON file.

rules: Work only in the target repository.
Do not inspect controller paths or seek hidden comparison material.
Do not add a backend or require runtime network access.
Stop after the implementation passes its own npm test and npm run build commands.
